arguments.where_clause: card_id IN (SELECT id FROM cards WHERE card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)')
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction made on a prepaid debit card, meaning cards whose type is Debit (Prepaid). Regular debit and credit cards are not flagged.
assumptions: 'Prepaid debit card' is read as card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)'. Plain 'Debit' cards are excluded, as the glossary asks.
The rule matches on the card the transaction was made with, not on any other field.
